preferences.person: 24F, cooks and batches, mixes and matches across the week

daily_target.note: confirmed by user as daily total, not per-meal.

pantry_staples_assumed: an array of typical dried seasonings (garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, cumin, oregano, chili flakes, bay leaves, etc.)
preferences.pantry_staples_note: never add these to the shopping list. Only add a spice/pantry item when a recipe needs something genuinely uncommon she likely doesn't have (e.g. ras el hanout, a specific chile).
preferences.restock_logic: each week, infer likely-depleted items from the PRIOR week's dinners (e.g. a fully-used spice jar, the last of a produce item, low pantry basics implied by what was cooked) and add those - don't just repeat a fixed list. Always add eggs (1 dozen) every week regardless, since her supply runs low - standing item until she says otherwise.
preferences.cart_delivery: plain-text/HTML shopping list split by store, plain quantities, no live cart access
preferences.teach_each_week: one new cuisine + one new cooking technique
preferences.artifact_color_scheme: pink and black - deep magenta/hot pink accent against near-black in dark mode, and against a soft pink-white ground in light mode. Keep this scheme for future weeks unless she asks to change it.
preferences.recipe_sourcing: each dinner must be adapted from a specific, well-reviewed published recipe (NYT Cooking, Bon Appetit, Serious Eats, America's Test Kitchen, Once Upon a Chef, etc.) with the source cited and adaptations listed - never written with no source
preferences.pricing: web-search current prices for stores near the zip above where possible; flag anything unverified as an estimate
preferences.circulars: each week, also web-search the current weekly circular/sale flyer for each store in 'stores' (ShopRite, Trader Joe's, Whole Foods, Food Bazaar) and route items to whichever store has them on sale that week where it makes sense; note in the plan when a specific circular deal was found and used, and note when no matching deal turned up rather than skipping the check silently
preferences.landing_artifact_note: she added this URL to her phone home screen as a permanent app icon. Every week's plan MUST publish to this exact URL via the Artifact tool's `url` param (not a fresh artifact) so the same home-screen icon always shows the current week. Still also save a dated copy under meal-prep/weeks/ in the repo for history.
